product.name: Edge.org
product.description: An online platform hosting conversations, essays, and lectures by scientists and thinkers to explore complex ideas across disciplines.

product.name: Edge Annual Question
product.description: An annual curated question posed to leading thinkers, generating a collection of short essays exploring diverse perspectives on a single theme.

product.name: Edge Conversations
product.description: Edited interviews and discussions with experts that present complex scientific and cultural ideas in accessible formats.

product.name: Edge Audio Library
product.description: A collection of recorded talks and lectures by scientists and intellectuals on diverse scientific and cultural topics.

product.name: Edge Books and Publications
product.description: Printed volumes compiling essays, lectures, and conversations from Edge.org contributors on various scientific and cultural themes.
